text:
Maria (partnerships): Quick sync — ACME wants a marketplace-exclusive commit path tied to their SI bundle. Can we map an offer?
Devon - Sales: timeline = launch week of Jun 3. they'd like a 3-month private window before public listing.
Juniper - Legal: Need to confirm reseller flow, EULAs for HW credits, and disclosure language for private terms.
Sam (SI lead): SI needs a SKU that includes onboarding hours + integration tests. Prefer single private offer, not multiple SKUs.
Maria (partnerships): Idea: create a timeboxed "onramp" private offer: 12-month commit, upfront credits for HW, tiered discounts after commit thresholds.
Devon - Sales: target commit numbers: $150k first year w/ 2-tier discounts at 100k and 250k. Can we map pricing bands?
Maria (partnerships): Yes — ops-bot, can you pull current marketplace discount caps and marketplace listing lead times?
ops-bot: market-data: discount_cap=25%, typical-listing=7d, private-offer-processing=2d
Juniper - Legal: Language note: must call out "usage credits" vs "rebates" to avoid tax complexity.
Sam (SI lead): Implementation note for platform: need a dedicated SKU code for ACME-SI so billing broker can attach onboarding credits.
Maria (partnerships): Proposed SKU CSV for ops:
```csv
sku,term,commit_min,initial_credit,discount_cap
ACME-ONRAMP-1,12,150000,30000,20%
ACME-HW-KICK,12,50000,20000,0%
``` 
Devon - Sales: Looks good. Can engineering give a 7d turnaround for private offer creation and test listing?
Maria (partnerships): @Sam take on ENG handoff — include canary routing to Dedicated vs Hosted for latency-sensitive flows.
Sam (SI lead): Got it. We'll open a short ENG ticket and assign next sprint. I'll draft the acceptance criteria.
Juniper - Legal: I'll prep a one-paragraph disclosure + partner signature block for the private offer.
Maria (partnerships): Thanks all. Follow-ups: Sam to create ENG ticket; Ops to reserve SKU; Juniper to send legal blurb. Ping back by EOD Thu.
Devon - Sales: pinged ACME to confirm acceptance window. :thumbsup:
